name: Crushing and Ore Doubling
description: Create turns one ore into more metal.

pages.title: Crushing and Ore Doubling
pages.text: Create turns one ore into more metal. You crush the raw ore, then wash or smelt the **crushed** result. Two machines crush: the Millstone and Crushing Wheels.

pages.title: Millstone
pages.text: Grinds items slowly and cheaply. Throw items in at the top, take the result out with right-click or automation. Good for flour, dyes and bone meal.

pages.title: Crushing Wheels
pages.text: Used as a pair spinning toward each other. Fast, and the standard way to crush ore. Drop items in at the top.
Crushing a raw ore **block**, like iron ore, gives a crushed item, a 75%% chance of a second one, XP nuggets and sometimes cobble. Raw ore items give one crushed item plus XP.

pages.title: Crushed Raw Iron
pages.text: Wash it in a fan for nine nuggets and a chance of redstone. Zinc, copper and gold give gunpowder, clay and quartz instead. Smelting works too.

The trick: crush ore blocks, not raw items, for the bonus crushed ore, then [#](2E5AAC)[wash](entry://create_basics/fans)[#]() for byproducts.

Where ores are is in [#](2E5AAC)[the Ore Guide](entry://materials/ore_guide)[#](). See also [#](2E5AAC)[Materials](entry://create_basics/materials)[#]().
